sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You punch the ground and conjure an eruption of lava and magma, enough to fill a 45-foot cube originating from you. All creatures in range, must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 3d10 Fire and 3d10 Earth damage and are Molten until the end of your next turn and Bruised on a failed save. Creatures who succeed, take half damage and no further effects. Creatures in range repeat this saving throw at the beginning of each of your turns.

Additionally, the affected area becomes Molten Terrain for the duration.

If this jutsu is cast while you are in your Lava Chakra Mode state, it can be cast as a Bonus Action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d10 for each damage type, and the cube size by 5 feet.
